citation: Proyecto MapBiomas Paraguay – Colección 1 de mapas de área quemada (MapBiomas Fuego), accedido a través de Google Earth Engine.
method: Sum of the geodesic area of 30 m pixels marked as burned (annual product value 1; monthly product value = month), inside simplified geoBoundaries ADM1 departments; the country is the sum of its departments. Each pixel counts once per year.
